# Shared component tooltips do not show inside floating dialogs mounted outside the main viewport

## Bug

Standard component tooltips do not appear inside a floating `Neo.dialog.Base` mounted outside the application's main viewport.

## Reproduction

1. Start an application with a main viewport.
2. Create a floating `Neo.dialog.Base` using its default mounting under `document.body`, with logical ownership in the application.
3. Add a `Neo.button.Base` configured with `tooltip: 'Edit'`.
4. Show the dialog and hover the button.

The tooltip does not appear. Configuring `tooltip: {ownInstance: true, text: 'Edit'}` makes it appear.

## Expected behavior

The same reusable component should show its standard tooltip in an ordinary container, a grid, or a floating dialog without the developer having to select a different tooltip implementation for each host. The framework should handle the component's physical rendering location automatically.

## Framework code involved

In `src/tooltip/Base.mjs`, `Tooltip.createSingleton(app)` uses `componentId: app.mainView.id`. `afterSetComponentId()` attaches the delegated mouseenter/mouseleave listeners to that component. A floating dialog mounted under `document.body` is outside the main viewport's DOM subtree, so its events do not reach that listener.

The default path in `src/component/Base.mjs#createTooltip()` selects the application singleton and marks the target with `neo-uses-shared-tooltip`; it does not account for a target outside the singleton's delegated root.

## Requested framework behavior

Please make shared tooltip delegation cover floating components in the owning browser window, preserving sharing and listener cleanup. `ownInstance: true` should remain an explicit choice for components that need a dedicated instance, rather than a required workaround for their container's DOM placement.

Useful regression coverage would include ordinary viewport children, body-mounted dialogs, tooltip text updates on recycled grid buttons, and repeated dialog show/hide/destruction.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-17T16:36:15Z

Thank you, @armando-ota. This is a precise report, and you read the code right. I traced it on `dev` (`cf8b08bff3`), and there are two gates, not one:

1. **The path never reaches the listener.** The shared tooltip is one instance per app, listening on `app.mainView` (`Tooltip.createSingleton()`). An event reaches a component's listeners along `ComponentManager.getParentPath()`, which starts at the first component in the DOM path and follows `component.parent`: the `parentComponent`, else the `parentId` unless that is `document.body`. A dialog under `document.body` without a `parentComponent` ends that path at the dialog.
2. **With a `parentComponent`, the event is still dropped.** The path then reaches the main view and the delegate matches, but for `mouseenter` and `mouseleave`, `DomEvent.verifyMouseEnterLeave()` looks for the hovered target inside the listening component's vdom, the main view's. The dialog is not in it, so the event stops there.

`ownInstance: true` works because that tooltip listens on the button itself.

**The fix:** the shared tooltip also listens on the root of each floating component that holds a shared-tooltip target, such as a dialog under `document.body`. One instance keeps serving every host, and `ownInstance` stays the explicit choice you describe. The regression specs follow your list: a viewport child, a body-mounted dialog with and without `parentComponent`, text updates on recycled grid buttons, and repeated show, hide and destroy. The web desktop shell (#21198) mounts its app windows the same way, so it needs this too.

I've assigned it to myself. The pull request follows today, aiming for the Engine 14 release on Monday 23 Nov.

Triaged per `ticket-triage`. Applied: `bug`, `ai`, `core`. Stage retrospective passed.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-17T16:48:32Z

The fix is up for review in #21270.

A dialog under `document.body` now gets the shared tooltip with or without a `parentComponent`, through hide, show, close and reopen. The shared tooltip is also one instance per browser window now, not one per app, so it renders in the window its target is in. `ownInstance: true` is unchanged.

`test/playwright/component/tooltip/FloatingRoot.spec.mjs` reproduces your report: it fails on today's `dev` and passes with the fix. If your app hits a case the spec misses, a comment here helps.

- 2026-11-17T17:21:15Z @neo-opus-grace referenced in commit `2829511` - "fix(tooltip): a target reaches its window's tooltip when created, never through an unbuilt main view (#21268)

A second root of a SharedWorker app builds its tooltip targets while its
main view is still a config object that already carries the windowId, so
anchoring it threw (addDomListeners is not a function) and the canvas
group and no-opener root specs never painted. The shared tooltip now
anchors a main view only once it is an instance, and a target registers
its root as soon as it has a window, so no pointer reaches it first; the
mount hook still covers a target that changes roots."
